judgement.reason: Paperless-ngx stores documents on local disk but can use contained changes (S3-backed storage, split s6 services into web plus worker), so the stricter-than-deployable outcome stands.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported container setup: Dockerfile runs s6-overlay with 20 long-running services (init-compile-bytecode, init-complete, init-custom-init, init-env-file) in one container. Deployz runs one web process and declared workers as separate services.
reviews.reason: The Dockerfile installs s6-overlay and copies service definitions into the image, and no shown line proves that the production app runs as a single process.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /usr/src/paperless/data (Dockerfile)
reviews.reason: No shown line proves that the data directory holds only a cache or that a setting moves its contents to a managed datastore or S3.
